flows:
Navigate to https://gs.statcounter.com/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
From fresh page focus, press Tab six times.
The Edit Chart Data control is immediately after the Statcounter Global Stats logo link.
When Edit Chart Data has focus, press Enter once.
Open it using the keyboard and verify the chart settings form shows the Region selector.
